description: Implementation of a generic channel equalizer supporting Zero Forcing (ZF) and Minimum Mean Square Error (MMSE) algorithms, including functions for different configurations of antenna ports and layers, with support for SIMD optimizations and validation routines.

classes.name: channel_equalizer_generic_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for a generic channel equalizer supporting ZF and MMSE algorithms.

methods.name: assert_sizes
methods.description: Validates that input and output data structures have matching dimensions.

methods.name: equalize_zf_single_tx_layer
methods.description: Performs ZF equalization for a specified number of ports, with recursion for reduction.

methods.name: equalize_zf_single_tx_layer<1>
methods.description: Specialization for a single port ZF equalization.

methods.name: equalize_zf_single_tx_layer_reduction
methods.description: Reduces the number of ports by filtering invalid noise variances and recursively calls the equalizer.

methods.name: equalize_zf_mxn
methods.description: Performs ZF equalization for multiple layers and ports, with SIMD optimization.

methods.name: equalize_mmse_mxn
methods.description: Performs MMSE equalization for multiple layers and ports, with SIMD optimization.

methods.name: channel_equalizer_generic_impl::is_supported
methods.description: Checks if a given configuration of ports, layers, and algorithm is supported.

methods.name: channel_equalizer_generic_impl::equalize
methods.description: Main function to perform channel equalization based on configuration and algorithm type.
